parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The duplicate of 'DebugMetricsProvider.setUpDisplayLink' in that file is almost certainly a local copy introduced to keep the sample-app target free of a hard dependency on the 'DebugPanel' package. Merging it back into 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' would couple the example target to production infrastructure, which is precisely the coupling the restraint rule is designed to prevent. No refactor is warranted unless the sample-app copy is confirmed to be a leftover prototype that should simply be deleted.
